items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: That's Mrs. Brown. That's sorts of Biloxi.

ctx.x: Is he still working at the Broadwater?
No. No. He's not at the Broadwater anymore. That's Mrs. Brown. That's sorts of Biloxi. No, he's down in Boca Raton, Florida, I think. Some friends of mine told me they saw him down there.

items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: I didn't ask for it, but when I went to pay a bill that said it was compliments of Mrs. Brown.

ctx.x: I don't know, I can't remember.

I remember when you had to, in fact, I used to go over there. I knew that one of the, you know, one of the relatives over there. In fact, I used to go over there for nothing. I used to get a room for nothing. And, uh, I never had any problems. I mean, I didn't ask for it, but when I went to pay a bill that said it was compliments of Mrs. Brown.
Who else were in the Southern Syncopators with you?
